Upstream of P-3301A the line runs PipeTee #4 -> GTV-33001 -> STR-33008 -> PipeTee #1 -> P-3301A. GTV-33001 is the only valve on that path, so closing it isolates the pump, which matches the reference. The system listed hundreds of valves (BFV-*, GTV-* and others) from across the plant, far more than the single valve needed, so it is wrong.
T-3901 has several inlet paths: GTV-38007 via Tee #10, GTV-39024, LV-39041 via SG-39042, and E-3901 via Tee #9 (steam supply isolated by GTV-39002 and GV-39001). An empty valve set cannot isolate it.

The pump has three outlets: the discharge via the property break (closed at GTV-23007 and FV-23013), the drain BV-23002, and the branch GTV-23008. The system omitted BV-23002 and GTV-23008, and BV-23001 is on a dead-end branch.

P-2201B has outlets via the main discharge (tee #2 -> CHV-22003/BFV-22003 and CHV-22004/XV-22006), via GTV-22005 and via the drain GTV-22006. The system omitted GTV-22006 (the drain line to tee #3) and GTV-22005, so the isolation is incomplete.

Isolating the pump's downstream side needs BV-19009 and GTV-19031 (direct outlets) plus BV-19008, BFV-19009 and GTV-19030 on the discharge branches. The system gave GTV-19030 and a nonexistent GTV-19021, missing the rest.
